worked_solution:
The unit step function $u(t)$ is defined as

$$
u(t)={\begin{aligned}1,\,t\ge 0, \\ 0,\,t<0.\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating $f(t)$ at $t=8,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(8) & =5u(8-8) \\  & =5u(0) \\  & =5\cdot 1 \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(8)=5.$
